This '''being''' was a [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] serving in the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the adoptive [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Darth Malgus|Veradun]] (later known as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Malgus). After Veradun [[Death/Legends|killed]] one of his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] servants, his adoptive father proudly sent him to the [[Sith Academy (Dromund Kaas)|Sith Academy]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] for training in the ways of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. As a result of this training, Veradun became the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Malgus, a powerful [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] leader of the Empire. He appeared to be a supporter of the Empire's works, and his personal zoo was funded by the Empire.
